purpose: Source-backed incident response controls and runbook structure. No incident, alert-delivery, credential-revocation or recovery drill was executed in this planning/implementation phase.

requiresApproval: external notification and legal/privacy reporting responsibility
who may authorize credential revocation, transaction suspension and data restoration

severityModel.meaning: Confirmed or strongly suspected critical security compromise, financial integrity breach, broad sensitive-data exposure or loss of authoritative business data.
Material service degradation, recurring payment/booking integrity risk, privileged-access failure or significant provider/Gateway delivery disruption.
Limited-scope functional fault with known containment and no current indication of data/financial compromise.
Low-impact defect or non-critical operational issue managed through normal support workflow.

roles.responsibility: Own severity, coordination, timeline and authorized decisions.
Contain affected service, preserve technical evidence and coordinate recovery.
Assess credentials/access/data exposure, audit evidence and security containment.
Validate booking/payment/ledger invariants and reconcile ambiguous transactions.
Approve internal, customer, provider and regulatory communication as applicable.
Maintain timestamped decision/action/evidence log with sensitive-value redaction.

requiredActions: record UTC detection time and correlation/test/run IDs
classify suspected impact and affected component
avoid printing tokens, OTPs, credentials or raw signed URLs
establish incident commander and technical/security/finance owners
record current known facts separately from hypotheses
decide severity using the approved model
use least-disruptive approved containment
revoke/rotate exposed credentials through authorized process
disable affected integration or privileged route only with recorded authorization
never route test traffic to LIVE or connect a client directly to the business database
preserve redacted logs, audit events, build revision and relevant configuration history
calculate hashes for exported evidence and restrict access
do not delete or overwrite evidence to make a service appear healthy
fix the verified root cause
restore only from checksum-verified backup to an explicitly approved local/target environment
reconcile booking/payment/ledger/OTP/Gateway state against authoritative records
verify security boundaries and business invariants
confirm duplicate/unknown payment or delivery outcomes are reconciled
record unresolved defects and explicit rollback/forward-fix decision
use approved severity-specific update cadence after RX-DEC-052 is approved
share only necessary, verified information
avoid exposing personal data, secrets or exploit detail in broad channels
document timeline, impact, root cause, containment and recovery evidence
create corrective actions with owners and deadlines after approval
review whether release gates, threat model or runbooks need updates

immediateActions: restrict access to the exposed surface
preserve redacted audit/CI evidence
rotate or revoke through approved key/provider workflow
check for unauthorized use
evidence: secret type and location without value

playbooks.scenario: Unauthorized Admin/Super Admin action or geographic-scope bypass
immediateActions: preserve session/audit/authorization evidence
revoke affected sessions if authorized
disable compromised account or operation through approved control
review affected records and export history
evidence: request IDs, actor IDs, role/scope and action IDs; no bearer token

playbooks.scenario: Duplicate, mismatched, forged or ambiguous payment/refund/settlement
immediateActions: pause only the affected financial path under approved authority
preserve provider event IDs and signature-verification outcomes
reconcile provider state, PaymentAttempt, ledger and settlement before manual correction
evidence: transaction IDs, amount/currency snapshots and provider correlation IDs; redact payment secrets

playbooks.scenario: OTP abuse, repeated failed attempts or account takeover indicators
immediateActions: preserve attempt/configuration/audit history under retention rules
apply approved rate-limit/session-revocation controls
do not expose OTP or challenge secret in alerts
evidence: actor type/ID, purpose code, timestamp, request ID, safe reason

immediateActions: restrict affected object/access path
preserve access audit without copying contents to broad logs
determine affected data subjects and object references
apply approved notification/legal-hold workflow
evidence: object IDs, access timestamps, authorization outcome and verified exposure scope

playbooks.scenario: Backend/database/provider outage or cascading timeout/retry amplification
immediateActions: check readiness/dependency metrics and retry/backlog limits
use bounded retries and approved degraded mode
avoid blind replay of non-idempotent operations
evidence: time window, component, error class, request IDs and queue depth

playbooks.scenario: Broadcaster/Gateway queue backlog, unauthorized command or ambiguous delivery state
immediateActions: pause unauthorized command path if approved
preserve job/lease/ACK/provider status transitions
reconcile before replay; do not infer delivery from HTTP acceptance alone
evidence: jobId, attemptId, gatewayId/deviceId and safe result code; exclude phone numbers/secrets unless strictly needed and access-controlled

playbooks.scenario: Database corruption or suspected data loss
immediateActions: stop destructive writes only with authorized decision
preserve database/backup metadata and relevant logs
verify recovery source/checksum and expected database identity
restore only to named disposable/approved target
evidence: backup checksum, database name/marker, schema revision and pre/post invariant report

playbooks.scenario: Realtime event audience leak, replay cursor abuse or stream resource exhaustion
immediateActions: restrict affected stream or replay path
preserve correlation IDs and event IDs without payload secrets
revoke/re-auth sessions when exposure indicates compromise
reconcile exposed audience/scope
evidence: actor/scope IDs, cursor range, event IDs and response metadata; never retain tokens/raw signed URL query

playbooks.scenario: TEST/LIVE boundary violation or unapproved remote database/provider target
immediateActions: stop the affected process/path
preserve redacted environment key names and target classification, not credential values
verify no write occurred and assess downstream provider/DB audit
restore approved local-only configuration
evidence: build/environment ID, safe host class and request/process IDs; no URL credentials

evidencePolicy.accessPolicy: Least privilege; preserve original timestamps; redacted copies for broad review; never alter original evidence to hide a failure.
